termZh: 边框- 左下- 弧度
definitionZh: 边框-左下方-射线CSS属性通过指定定义角曲面的椭圆半径(或半主轴和半小轴半径)来包围元素的左下角.
sourceDefinition: The border-bottom-left-radius CSS property rounds the bottom-left corner of an element by specifying the radius (or the radius of the semi-major and semi-minor axes) of the ellipse defining the curvature of the corner.

sourceEvidence.sourceDefinition: The border-bottom-left-radius CSS property rounds the bottom-left corner of an element by specifying the radius (or the radius of the semi-major and semi-minor axes) of the ellipse defining the curvature of the corner.
